**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Provide the original-fixture inputs**

After Step 9 mutates the only committed `manifest.json` and `patches.json` with five new seeds, this control cannot be run as written: the repository contains no separate original-thirteen fixture paths, and neither the plan nor runbook explains how to materialize them. The operator must therefore invent inputs, so the mandatory AC8 original-fixture comparison is not reproducible. Add versioned original-fixture artifacts or an explicit deterministic command that extracts the pre-extension files and name the resulting paths here.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
